name: Top-down Adventure
tagline: Zelda-lite room exploration with sword combat.
description: Top-down 2D adventure starter. Player with 4-directional walk, sword attack, HP bar, one enemy type with attack AI, a 16x16 tileset for grass/path/wall, a single room with a key and door pattern.
prompt_template: Build a Unity 2D top-down adventure. Player has 4-directional walk animations (up/down/left/right) and a sword swing on space. Add HP bar (3 hearts). One enemy goblin patrols and attacks when player is close. Room with grass tileset, walls, one key pickup, and a door that opens when key is held. Camera follows player.
